battleFormations.name: Darkflight Pursuit
battleFormations.effect: Black-winged Vigilance: Friendly RAVENWING FLY units' ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]. Friendly OUTRIDER SQUAD units gain the BATTLELINE keyword. Restriction: army can include DARK ANGELS units only, no other Chapter's ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

battleFormations.name: Inner Circle Task Force
battleFormations.effect: Vowed Target: In your Command phase you can pick one objective marker to be your vowed objective until your next Command phase. Friendly DEATHWING INFANTRY units add 1 to the Wound roll for attacks that target an enemy unit within range of that objective. Restriction: army can include DARK ANGELS units only, no other Chapter's ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

battleFormations.name: Wrath of the Rock
battleFormations.effect: Dutiful Tenacity: Each time an attack targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army, if the attack's Strength is greater than that unit's Toughness, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

artefacts.name: Nightforged Battery (Upgrade)
artefacts.effect: [LAND SPEEDER VENGEANCE unit only] The unit can re-roll rolls made to determine a weapon's Attacks and can re-roll Hazard rolls.

artefacts.name: Thundercowl Turbines (Upgrade)
artefacts.effect: [RAVENWING FLY or MOUNTED unit only] In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

artefacts.name: Champion of the Deathwing
artefacts.effect: [DEATHWING model only] The bearer's unit's attacks that target an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

artefacts.name: Singular Will
artefacts.effect: [DEATHWING model only] When the bearer's unit makes a consolidation move, it can move up to D3+3".

artefacts.name: Ancient Weapons
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] The bearer's melee attacks get +2 Strength and +1 AP.

artefacts.name: Deathwing Assault
artefacts.effect: [DEATHWING model with Deep Strike only] In your first Movement phase, the bearer's unit can make an ingress move.

artefacts.name: Lord of the Ravenwing
artefacts.effect: [RAVENWING model only] The bearer's unit can re-roll charge rolls.

artefacts.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of the bearer can re-roll Leadership rolls.

armyRules.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRules.effect: At the start of your Command phase you may pick one Combat Doctrine; it stays active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until your next Command phase. Assault Doctrine: Advancing does not stop the unit declaring a charge. Devastator Doctrine: the unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. Tactical Doctrine: Falling Back does not stop the unit shooting or declaring a charge. Each Doctrine can be picked once per battle, and a unit can only have one active Doctrine at a time.
